residual_amplitude_definition: P_res(k,mu) = lambda times clean forecast thermal-noise power at one retained year; dimensionless POWER ratio in forecast covariance coordinates.
component_acceptance: Both abs(bias_i)/sigma_i <= 1; this conjunction is not a two-dimensional confidence ellipse.
precision_definition: Full six-parameter clean-model marginalized dilation covariance at one retained year. Equality with the clean benchmark here is by construction, not a measured mask response or independently established BAO detection threshold.
observing_cost: No policy cost is exported. T=1/f only with qualified uniform information thinning; count retention alone does not establish it.
linear_response_limit: First-order additive-power bias reference; finite-amplitude validity and actual coherent-mean/covariance transfer remain unmeasured.
time_limit: The reference exposure was fixed before evaluation. Three-time diagnostics provide no continuous-time guarantee and do not overwrite the original archive gate.
numerical_error_limit: Empirical refinement comparisons are numerical qualification, not rigorous error bounds.
